intro.title: The bass clef
intro.text: This is the bass clef, for lower notes, usually your left hand. Its two dots wrap around the F line (F3).

intro.title: Left-hand fingers
intro.text: The left hand is numbered the same way: thumb 1, pinky 5. In C position your left pinky is on C3, the C below middle C.

intro.title: C
intro.text: C3 is in the second space from the top.

intro.title: D
intro.text: D3 is on the middle line.

intro.title: E
intro.text: E3 is in the space above the middle line.
